capabilities: sync memos from a Memos server into Markdown notes with frontmatter
embed synced memo notes into Daily Notes under a configurable heading
download memo image attachments into the vault
run smart, incremental, or force sync modes on demand, at startup, or on a schedule
keep replies with parent memos or save them as separate notes
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. On Obsidian versions older than 1.11.4 the API token is stored in the plugin's data instead of Secret Storage. Sync requires Daily Notes or Periodic Notes to be enabled.
problem: Memos posts live on a separate server and aren't searchable or linkable in Obsidian; this pulls them into the vault as notes tied to the day they were written.

relations.evidence: a reachable Memos server, and an API token from Memos > Settings > Access Tokens

summary: Syncs memos from a self-hosted Memos server into Markdown notes embedded in your Daily Notes, with image attachments and three sync modes.
